# Spinner > Accessible loading indicator for pending buttons, panels, and inline waits. This file matches the installed `spinner` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/spinner.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/spinner.md`. ## npm dependencies - `lucide-react@^1.78.0` ## Registry dependencies - `core` - `effects` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/spinner-knobs`: `spinnerKnobs`, types `SpinnerKnobStyle` - `@/components/control-ui/ui/spinner`: `Spinner`, types `SpinnerProps` ## Composition ### Pending indicator ```tsx ``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { Button } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/button"; import { Spinner } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/spinner"; export function PrimitiveSpinnerExample() { return (
); } ``` ## Anatomy Scopes, their parts, and the state attributes each part carries. Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `spinner` - `indicator`: `data-size` (`lg` | `md` | `sm` | `xs`) - `root`: `data-motion-essential` ## Knobs Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin. ### spinner - `--cui-spinner-foreground`: `var(--muted-foreground)` - `--cui-spinner-animation-duration`: `var(--duration-loop)` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/components/spinner - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/spinner.json
